scope: One supplied full-output enumeration baseline. No literature expansion.

checks.finding: A simple undirected graph admits a randomized (Δ+1)-edge-coloring algorithm in O(m log n) time w.h.p.
The sharpened O(m log Δ) randomized bound w.h.p. applies to simple graphs. Parts (2) and (3) concern multigraphs and are not imported into this binary matrix model.

checks.location: Appendix C.1, including Lemmas C.2 and C.4 and its final proof paragraph
checks.finding: The sharpened stage completes w.h.p.; it is not presented here as a merely expected-time bound. No fixed probability exponent or Las Vegas classification is invented.

atlasDerivation.enumeration: Known n-vertex set; query each unordered pair u<v once. There are exactly n(n−1)/2 pairs. Retain m edges and compute Δ during the scan. This is deterministic, independent of graph density.
atlasDerivation.composition: The stored graph is passed to Corollary C.1(1), with no further matrix-oracle calls. Add scan time O(n²) and output m edge–color assignments separately.
atlasDerivation.edgeCases: For Δ=0 there are no output edges; for Δ=1 all edges receive color 1. This yields the explicitly labeled all-degree extension O(m log max{2,Δ}) after scanning.
atlasDerivation.lowerBounds: None added. The exact count of this algorithm is not asserted to be a necessary number of queries for every algorithm.
atlasDerivation.storage: Only O(m) stored edges is recorded; no total-memory theorem is inferred.

corrections.before: STOC 2025 main coloring theorem; O(m log Δ) computation; numeric exponent plot
corrections.after: Corollary C.1(1) supplies the degree-sensitive bound. Exact deterministic query count and randomized post-scan time are distinct. Numeric research plot removed; curated axes use symbolic n/n² order with exact query annotation.

representation.main: One green point: exact palette Δ+1 × quadratic query order, annotated n(n−1)/2. The detail view adds density-independent scan explanation and an explicit scan/color/output accounting row.

representation.lowerBoundStatus: No matrix-query lower bound is verified in the supplied source set. No optimality claim is made.
